card.name: Soldado Críptico
card.summary: Ao batalhar com Guerreiro, ganha 2000 ATK/DEF apenas durante o cálculo de dano.

textEvidence.text: A battle involving this monster and a Warrior gives this monster an additional 2000 ATK and 2000 DEF exclusively during damage calculation. Both attack and defense battles qualify. Outside that calculation its printed values apply; a non-Warrior opponent gives no bonus. The modifier has no cost, target, choice or activation once-per-turn limit, and is suppressed by monster effect negation. Its former printed English name is Kinetic Soldier; Cipher Soldier is the current name of the same identity, not a second card.

card.name: Bugroth Anfíbio
card.summary: Fusão: Bugroth de Ataque Terrestre + Sentinela dos Mares; sem efeito.

textEvidence.text: This non-Effect Fusion Monster requires precisely Ground Attacker Bugroth and the historical Defender of the Sea, whose canonical present identity is Sentinel of the Seas. Its recipe has no additional effect or special summoning restriction. It is Level 5, WATER, Aqua, 1850 ATK and 1300 DEF. Ordinary Fusion, ownership, Extra Deck and properly-summoned revival rules apply; there is no monster effect to activate or negate.
